ashley: passing handoff for night shift — short summary first: embeddings autoscaler started oscillating in eu-west around 02:10 UTC, caused repeated node churn and KV/cache evictions. we saw p95 embed-latency spike ~3x and ~12 customer 5xxs between 02:12–02:30. incident-bot paged at 02:16. i triaged and applied a mitigation; leaving notes and next steps below.

incident-bot: PAGE: SRE — embeddings-autoscaler-thrash (priority: P2) triggered by autoscaler_flap_alert. responders: ashley (primary), rafael (secondary).

rafael: saw the same — autoscaler reacted to noisy CPU from batch-merge pods and flapped replicas 3->0->3. KV leader eviction logs indicate cache pressure. pinned autoscaler cooldown to 240s which stopped immediate churn.

maria: checked customer impact dashboard — the 12 5xxs were from 3 customers, mostly european, caused by failed embed writes leading to fallback into retry loop. i triggered customer-notify for 2 high-volume customers (CS notified). :white_check_mark:

jin: quick note on fallback behavior — requests that hit a missing KV entry get retried and sometimes queue behind long-running quantize jobs. i spun up a small pool of quantized workers to absorb load.

ashley: mitigation steps executed (chronological):
1) set autoscaler cooldown to 240s and min_replicas=2 for embeddings-autoscaler in eu-west
2) scaled quantized-worker pool +2 replicas
3) enabled prefix cache bypass for affected route for ~10m to reduce KV pressure
4) pushed temporary model-variant routing to smaller-quant model for low-priority tenants to reduce load on embed writer

commands used:
```
kubectl -n inference patch hpa embeddings-autoscaler -p '{"spec":{"behavior":{"scaleDown":{"stabilizationWindowSeconds":240}}}}'
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/quantized-workers --replicas=$(($(kubectl -n inference get deploy quantized-workers -o jsonpath='{.status.replicas}')+2))
```

log snippet (sanitized):
```
[02:11:43] autoscaler: measure: cpu=78% -> target 65%
[02:11:44] autoscaler: scale to 3 replicas
[02:11:47] kv-cache: eviction: leader=embed-shard-17 entries=3121
[02:12:02] autoscaler: scale to 0 replicas
[02:12:04] requests: embed_write error 503 upstream: kv-miss
```

ashley: current status — stabilized at ~02:34 after cooldown + scale. p95 embed latency back to baseline within ~20m of mitigation. autoscaler remains pinned with cooldown 240s and min_replicas=2. no active pages. customer impact tracked; CS follow-ups in ticket #INC-4922.

maria: tickets opened: INC-4922 (customer impact + notify), OPS-emb-thrash-1795 (postmortem + telemetry captures). i've attached the sampling prompts and failing request IDs in OPS ticket.

oncall-manager: coverage note — primary for next shift (overnight->morning) is rafael, secondary is maria. please ack and confirm handover in 10m. there is a gap for APAC regional oncall between 00:00–06:00 PST; we should add another person to rotation or enable cross-region alerts.

rafael: acked. i'll take primary and keep autoscaler patched until morning. i'll also follow up with infra to investigate noisy CPU from batch-merge pods.

jin: follow-up items i recommend:
- collect flamegraphs from batch-merge at 02:00–02:20 window
- add circuit-breaker on embed-write to avoid retry storms when KV-miss rate > 5%
- add metric: autoscaler_flap_count per 10m window and alert at 2+ flaps

ashley: consolidated runbook pointers:
- runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/embeddings-autoscaler-thrash
- embed-write playbook: https://redwood-internal/playbooks/embed-write-fallback
- rollback steps (if autoscaler must be fully disabled): see section 4 of runbook above.

maria: post-handoff note for morning team — we should review quantized-worker scaling policy; current manual bump was +2 to absorb backlog. consider autoscaling config tuning and warm pools for high-load windows.

oncall-manager: action items (assigned):
- rafael: investigate batch-merge CPU spike + attach flamegraphs (due: morning)
- jin: prototype circuit-breaker for embed-write (due: 72h)
- maria: draft customer summary for CS and attach to INC-4922 (due: 3h)
- ashley: write short timeline + ops checklist for postmortem (due: EOD)

ashley: final: please react with :eyes: once you read. i'll be available on slack for 30m for any quick handover questions. thanks and smooth shift.

rafael: :eyes: taking primary.

maria: :eyes: will draft customer note.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (monitoring) — autoscaler_flap_alert cleared after config change. no active pages.

oncall-manager: noted — next scheduled coverage swap at 08:00 UTC. if anything degrades, page as usual and escalate to SRE lead.

[end of thread]
